published.source: Report re-sim on master 5bbcb0d, 2026-10-16: Grace of Air with Windfury in the melee raid, Windfury Totem main hand only, off-hand Rage 0.5 and channel pushback on hits taken (was 984.0)

summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party, with the raid's Battle Shout off.
rotation: Start in Berserker Stance with no Rage; Bloodrage and Battle Shout 3s before the pull
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Battle Shout again with 35s of it left (about 142s in, before the execute phase), unless it lasts the fight (Forever's lasts 3 min)
Death Wish right after the Sunder, Recklessness one GCD later
Racial cooldowns with Death Wish (Blood Fury and Berserking also at the end of the fight); trinket on cooldown; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s
Execute first in the execute phase
Heroic Strike queued from 50 Rage (outside execute)
Hamstring filler from 10 Rage (procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: White hit Rage scales with weapon speed (measured at level 30, assumed ×1.5 at 60).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit. Each crit restarts the tick timer (our choice).
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 15.1.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 10.8 vs Humanoids.
Second Mighty Rage Potion held for the last 20s: +6.4 at 180s, -3.0 at 120s.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 15 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_fury -apl level60_fury_battle_shout -talents 30305013002-25053005122010501-2 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
